delete.title: Delete Account
delete.warningBanner: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
delete.whatHappensTitle: What happens when you delete your account
delete.whatHappensBody: Your account will be permanently deleted. You will lose access to TailorCraft and all data associated with your account. This action cannot be undone.
delete.dataRemovedBody: We will permanently delete your profile, company information, clients, orders, measurements, and any other data stored in your account.
delete.retentionBody: After deletion, we do not retain your personal data. Some anonymized or aggregated data may be kept only where required by law.
delete.subscriptionsBody: If you have an active subscription, you must cancel it before deleting your account. Deleting your account does not automatically cancel subscriptions; manage billing in Subscription settings first.
delete.lossOfAccessBody: You will immediately lose access to the app and all your data. You will not be able to recover your account or data after deletion.
delete.reauthDescription: Enter your password to confirm your identity before proceeding.
delete.finalWarning: This is your last chance to cancel. Tapping the button below will permanently delete your account and all associated data.
delete.successMessage: Your account has been permanently deleted. You have been signed out.
delete.pendingMessage: Your account deletion has been scheduled. You will be signed out. If your provider supports it, you may still cancel before the deletion date from your email or support.
delete.errorGeneric: We could not delete your account. Please try again.
delete.errorNetwork: Connection failed. Check your network and try again.
delete.errorSubscriptionActive: You have an active subscription. Please cancel your subscription in Subscription settings first, then try again.
delete.errorAlreadyDeleted: This account has already been deleted.
delete.errorDeletionPending: Account deletion is already scheduled. You will be signed out.
